epics.sixSigmaMetric: Zero self-falsification cycle findings for PRs 1810, 1811, and 1812
requirements: R1: Resolve Finding 1 by fully implementing the omitted requirements from PR #1810: fixing HTTP 401 errors causing 15 test failures, Moodle SSO (OAuth2/OIDC/LTI), Moodle role hierarchy synchronization, and autonomous fallback for the external LMS

R2: Resolve Finding 2 by fully implementing the omitted requirement from PR #1811: fixing approval criteria to strictly ensure no PR is approved when brief requirements like Moodle access restrictions are omitted
R3: Resolve Finding 3 by addressing the PR #1812 approve verdict violation regarding PR #1811 omitting the mandated Acceptance Criteria for fixing the PR review approval criteria

slices.title: Resolve PR 1810-1812 Self-Falsification Findings
slices.jtbd: When implementing the self-falsification audit fixes for this epic, I want to resolve the HTTP 401 errors, Moodle SSO, role hierarchy sync, autonomous fallback, and approval criteria, so that all confirmed findings for PRs 1810, 1811, and 1812 are fully resolved
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an automated PR review request, When a brief requirement like Moodle access restrictions is omitted, Then the PR review approval criteria strictly ensures the PR is rejected.
Given a test run encountering HTTP 401 errors, When the system processes the requests, Then the Moodle SSO, role hierarchy synchronization, and autonomous fallback function correctly and no 401 errors occur.
